load_segmented_patch_data: load a patch file from a URL or repo path and return segmented image data with alpha masks
generate_collage_patches: generate low and high resolution patch data for a collage from a config dict and index
add_alpha_mask: add a binary alpha mask to an RGB patch where black pixels have alpha zero
resize_image_patch: resize an image patch by a given coefficient using cv2 resize
normalize_patch_brightness: normalize patch brightness by dividing by max intensity and scaling to 255
